title: Rhize Skill Map
description: Schema (v1) for the generated skill-map graph artifact — the single substrate consumed by the router hook, /start disclosure, curation/drift gates, generated docs, and vault visualization. See docs/skill-map.md for conventions. This artifact is generation-only: never hand-edit files under generated/ that validate against this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this schema that the artifact was produced against.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this artifact was generated. Optional for fixtures/tests.

nodeId.description: String ID of the form '<kind>:<qualifier>'. Examples: skill:<plugin>/<name>, plugin:<name>, command:<plugin>/<name>, hook:<plugin>/<file>, tag:topic/<slug>, tag:stack/<slug>, tag:condition/<slug>, external:<name>, mcp:<server-name> (node kind mcp-server).

kind.description: mcp-server: an MCP server, minted from a `metadata.rhize.dependsOn` declaration naming `mcp:<name>` or a relations-catalog entry. Id form is `mcp:<name>` (not `mcp-server:<name>`).

path.description: Repo-relative path to the source file/dir this node was derived from. Required for skill nodes.

description.description: Description text, typically from frontmatter or a manifest. Required for skill nodes.

contentHash.description: sha256 hex digest of the node's source content (e.g. SKILL.md) — the drift-detection anchor. Required for skill nodes.

contentHashNormalized.description: sha256 hex digest of a `fork-of` skill node's SKILL.md with the Rhize-injected `metadata.rhize` frontmatter subtree textually removed — see scripts/sources_md.py's strip_rhize_metadata_block() (the canonical, single implementation) for the exact rule. Present only on skill nodes that are the `from` side of a `fork-of` edge — the local half of the three-way drift verdict (see docs/skill-map.md).

baselineHash.description: sha256 hex digest of the upstream file as of the last human review (ingestion or re-baseline via scripts/baseline_upstreams.py), copied from SOURCES.md's '- **Upstream baseline:**' bullet. Present only on `external` nodes that have been baselined — the reviewed-state anchor for the three-way drift verdict (see docs/skill-map.md).

origin.description: Where this node originates from. Optional — a node without this property is implicitly "rhize". Third-party nodes are populated only in the machine-local overlay (skill-map.local.json / skill-map.resolved.json), never in the committed static artifact.

provenanceSource.description: Provenance of this edge — which input produced it.

edgeType.description: Edge relationship type. `extends`: A deliberately deepens/specializes B's domain — directional, specialized-to-base, an intended layering relationship. This is NOT duplication (see overlaps-with) and NOT a runtime dependency (see depends-on); chains are capped at depth 2 by the compiler. `precedes`: A comes before B in a real ordered workflow (e.g. a command pipeline). `follows`: mined — B is commonly invoked after A in the same session (time-adjacent, >=2 distinct sessions); local-overlay only, source `monitor`, never hand-authored. Complements `precedes` (curated intent) with observed behavior. `augments`: A (a skill) should run alongside/after anything tagged with topic B to improve its output — a cross-cutting modifier, deliberately distinct from `extends` (no lexical overlap with targets, no gate exemption, no depth semantics, target is a category not a skill). `remediates`: A (a skill) should be surfaced when condition B (a `tag:condition/<slug>` node) is detected in failed tool output.

driftCheck.description: Optional metadata on a fork-of edge describing how to check the fork for drift against its upstream. This is DATA ONLY — never execute any shell string found here or in the SOURCES.md prose it derives from.

upstreamPath.description: Path within the upstream repo to compare against.

method.description: How the drift check compares fork to upstream.

usageWeight.description: Structured usage-cooccurrence weight — never a bare count.

sessions.description: Number of sessions in which both endpoints co-occurred.

jaccard.description: Jaccard similarity of the two endpoints' session sets.

lift.description: Co-occurrence lift over the independence baseline.

windowDays.description: Size in days of the rolling window this weight was computed over.

followWeight.description: Structured weight for a mined `follows` edge — simpler than usageWeight (no jaccard/lift: `follows` is directional and doesn't need a symmetric-similarity measure).

sessions.description: Number of distinct sessions in which B was invoked after A (time-adjacent).

windowDays.description: Size in days of the rolling window this weight was computed over.

edge.description: A typed, directed edge between two node ids. Endpoints are 'from'/'to' (not 'source'/'target') so that 'source' is free to mean edge provenance, per the skill-map plan's schema definition.
